description: Runs curl for AI agents: Curl, the drop-in C# replacement for the curl command-line tool, over standard input and output.
name: io.github.StewartScottRogers/Curl

environmentVariables.name: CURL_MCP_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: The directory every file curl reads or writes must lie inside.

environmentVariables.name: CURL_MCP_MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: The most bytes of output a tool returns; 1048576 when unset.
